title: ChatSoundAssetRequest
description: chat.sound-asset-request@1: the body of POST /internal/chat/sounds/asset on OpenVibe.Chat (capability chat.sounds.write): after OpenVibe.Live's asset sync uploaded a channel sound to OpenVibe.Media, the asset is written back onto Chat's channel_sounds row id. Writing the same asset again is a no-op; an unknown id is 404. Answers chat.ingress-ack@1.
